summary: Prentiss County, MS steel lookout, 110 ft, surveyed in 1950 and found standing in 1979; the Forest Lookouts list marks it removed, with no date.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed on the Forest Lookouts site, with no date. The last recovery note on file, from 1979, found the tower standing.

corrections.why: The record's point is about 240 miles from Booneville, far from Prentiss County. NGS PID EG1514 places the mark in Prentiss County, 11 miles northeast of Booneville, at NAD 83 34 42 17.15868 N, 88 22 55.16278 W. Re-check on a map before publishing.

sources.title: NGS Data Sheet, PID EG1514 (Blue Hill Lookout Tower)

notes_for_editor: The record's coordinates were wrong (about 240 miles from the NGS position); the proposed correction uses the NGS NAD 83 position, not a geocoder, so check it on a map. No source gives a build date or removal date. A Facebook group post surfaced in a web search snippet, claiming removal at the landowner's request in 2005; the page could not be read, so it is unverified and not used in the story. Not on NHLR; FFLOS has no Mississippi entry for it. Story is about 180 words.
